name: Vane AI Answering Engine (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted AI answering engine with cited web results, bundled SearXNG search, and support for local Ollama models; no vendor-enforced software query quota.
watch_out: Run Docker and local LLMs on your own hardware; electricity, compute and hosting are not included. Optional OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or other hosted model APIs can incur separate charges. Formerly known as Perplexica; do not list both names separately.
